title: Приглашение к столу
idea: The hunter becomes a host. An empty chair makes the viewer the next guest.
scope: Fictional generated photographic still life; not an observed species, evidence of a custom or a suggestion to eat predatory fungi.
peer_review: Claude challenged the still life to become a prop inside an action. Codex added RSVP, new reply verses, printable invitation and folding place cards.
